other_conditions: Monthly family income must not exceed ₹15,000 for Lower Income Group (LIG) applicants
Monthly family income must not exceed ₹30,000 for Middle Income Group (MIG) applicants
Applicant must not own any pucca house or flat in their name or in the name of any family member (spouse, unmarried sons or daughters) in West Bengal
Applicant must be a resident of the same district where the project is implemented
Each applicant can apply for only one flat for their family
A beneficiary who has been allotted a flat cannot apply for the same scheme in another project within the same district
Joint applications are allowed only for a husband/wife or dependent parent of the primary applicant
benefits_summary: A house (1BHK for LIG or 2BHK for MIG) is allotted on an ownership basis through a transparent lottery, with credit‑linked subsidies facilitated by the Housing Department.
